g.title: HR_ABSENCEEVENTDETAIL

The identifier of Public Holiday record.

g.text: Absence Event - Contains the absence events.

Indicates the start date of the absence event.
Indicates the end date of the absence event.

Indicates the time of day when the absence event ends.
